'''Mieczysław Józef Mąkosza''' (16 November 1934 – 14 January 2026) was a Polish chemist who specialised in organic synthesis and investigation of organic mechanisms. Along with Jerzy Winiarski he is credited for the discovery of the aromatic [[vicarious nucleophilic substitution]], VNS. He also contributed to the discovery of [[phase transfer catalysis]] reactions. From 1979 to 2005 he was director of the Institute of Organic Chemistry of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Prof. Chmielewski: Nobla mógł dostać Polak |url=http://wyborcza.pl/1,76842,2953258.html |work=[[Gazeta Wyborcza]] |date=5 October 2005 |accessdate=31 October 2010 }}</ref> Mąkosza died on 14 January 2026, at the age of 91.<ref>{{cite web |title=Odszedł prof. Mieczysław Mąkosza |url=https://www.icho.edu.pl/odszedl-prof-mieczyslaw-makosza/ |website=ICHO |access-date=16 January 2026 |date=15 January 2026}}</ref>
